levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Candidates are vague or not real contributions.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least three specific, genuine candidate ideas.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Three specific candidates spanning different scopes or areas of the household.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Final choice has no stated reasoning against the criteria.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Final choice is justified against at least one criterion.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Final choice is justified against all three criteria with specific reasoning for each.

lookFors: Candidates are genuinely different from each other, not variations of the same idea.
Chosen contribution addresses a real, named need.
Reflection names which criterion mattered most, not a vague summary.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
